coverage.threshold_rule: At least 3 distinct dated comparable observations spanning at least 90 days from at least 2 independent origins, or a verified continuous price series covering at least 90 days.

limitations: No dated price for the previous Black Friday (2025-11-28) was verified; no fetched page showed a price for the exact GU55DU7199UXZG 55-inch model in that window.
No dated off-season observations (2025-11-29 to 2026-11-26) were verified apart from one Amazon listing dated 2026-11-25.

Only 3 fetches and 6 searches were allowed; Keepa, idealo, Geizhals (product page), Guenstiger, Heise Preisvergleich and testbericht were not verified by fetch (Geizhals, Guenstiger and Heise fetches failed or were unavailable earlier).

mydealz and Monsterdealz searches found no deal thread for the 55-inch DU7199 (GU55DU7199UXZG) model; only deal threads for other Samsung models (AU7199 2021, GU65DU7199, GU50DU7199 snippets) were seen and excluded.
Samsung DE official page was fetched, but its price fields are unrendered placeholders and it shows the product as out of stock; no price was recoverable.
The only verified observation (Amazon Market via HardwareSchotte, 539,00 EUR, dated 2026-11-25 02:55) shows no shipping cost and no stock status; shipping and availability are unknown.
Most price figures in the search snippets (Geizhals, eBay, Klarna, guenstiger) are undated or are only leads and were not verified; they are reported in unverified_leads only.
Historical retailer price history for the 55-inch model (including Euronics, Kaufland, MediaMarkt, Saturn, Otto, Lidl leads) was not verified for any date in the windows.
Other-size or other-model results (50-inch GU50DU7199, 65-inch GU65DU7199, 75-inch GU75DU7199, Neo QLED, The Frame) were excluded as different variants.
